DeployBot: Deployment complete: canary-3 -> prod-east/slot-9. Version v2.3.7. Smoke checks: http 200 OK, synth probes OK. Rolling: paused for 10m observation window.
Alex: Copy. Kicking off lightweight telemetry cross-checks (p95/p99, error rate, kv hit). Will post results.
InfraBot: synthetic-probe run @2026-03-21T14:20Z -> results: p50=18ms p95=163ms p99=320ms. Baseline p95=125ms. 5xx rate=0.0%. kvcache_miss=12% -> baseline 8%.
Priya: Hmm, p95 and p99 both up ~30%. No 5xx but kvcache miss rate bumped. Could be warmstart or a quantized kernel path for certain sequences. Can someone check kv TTL churn and prefill metrics?
Jamie: quick snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/d/telemetry/canary?panelId=7 shows p95 spike aligned with canary start :eyes:
Marta: No errors but latency SLO is near threshold for prod-east. Suggest we keep the canary pinned and hold the full rollout for 20m. If p95 > 150ms for two consecutive 5m windows, we rollback to v2.3.6.
Alex: Agreed. I'll wire a temporary watchdog to enforce that and post a short runbook here.
Alex: runbook snippet:
```
# watchdog pseudo
watch window=5m threshold.p95=150ms windows=2
if triggered: /releases rollback prod-east --to v2.3.6 --reason "postdeploy tail latency"
notify #eng-oncall, @ReleaseOwner
```
Priya: Also please check GPU queue depth and host GC at canary hosts. I'll tail traces and kvcache logs.
InfraBot: Watchdog configured: watch_id=watch_p95_canary_4462501234. rule: p95>150ms for 2 windows -> action=rollback_to v2.3.6. Notifications -> #eng-oncall, DM to @Alex.
DeployBot: Pin action queued: rollout paused, canary remains at v2.3.7 for observation. Release owner @Alex notified.
Jamie: OK. We'll hold and reassess at +20m. If telemetry returns to baseline, resume. If not, follow the rollback rule. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
